dialogues.speaker: Friendly Passenger
dialogues.text: Is there something wrong with the ship? Why is the Maison Gardiennage here...?

dialogues.speaker: Crewmember
dialogues.text: #Ah... Haha... I'm sure it's nothing. I think I saw the famous adventurer, {NICKNAME}, helping out, which means everything's certain to be under control.

dialogues.speaker: Crewmember
dialogues.text: No matter the situation, the captain can surely sort it out...

dialogues.speaker: Crewmember
dialogues.text: I just did what I was told... I won't get into trouble, right...?
